gaps.explanation: Schedule is ABOVE the statement by 33,631. Statement of Receipts, Disbursements, and Changes in Fund Balances - Cash Basis - Governmental Funds (p4): General Fund receipts Taxes 1,071,574 + Inheritance tax 2,719 + Intergovernmental 168,589 + Local 121,780 = 1,364,662; Total receipts 1,755,482. Sale of surplus 27,014 and Insurance proceeds 6,617 are printed under Other Financing Sources (p4, and the General Fund combining statement p5), not as receipts. The Budgetary Comparison Schedule - Cash Basis - General Fund (p8), which detail[0..2] come from, prints receipts on its budgetary basis: Taxes 1,071,734, Intergovernmental 168,189, Local 155,651 = TOTAL RECEIPTS 1,395,574 = the General Fund sub-column of p5 (1,361,943) + sale of surplus 27,014 + insurance proceeds 6,617; it counts those other financing sources among its receipts and also allocates the lines differently (Taxes +160, Intergovernmental -400, Local +33,871 vs p5). Net 160 - 400 + 33,871 = 33,631 = 27,014 + 6,617 = the gap. The other detail lines tie exactly: Inheritance Tax Fund 2,719 (p5), Road Fund 309,665 (p9 = p4 Road column), Non-Major combining statement 81,155 (pp6-7 = p4 Non-Major column); 1,395,574 + 2,719 + 309,665 + 81,155 = 1,789,113 = schedule total. Both printed totals stand (p8 1,395,574 vs p5 General Fund 1,361,943); no detail fix. (Only if the user wants the detail on the statement basis would detail[0] Taxes 1,071,734, detail[1] Intergovernmental 168,189 and detail[2] Local 155,651 be replaced by the p5 General Fund column lines Taxes 1,071,574, Intergovernmental 168,589, Local 121,780; that would discard the printed budget-schedule amounts, so it is not proposed.)
